Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: origen_163463.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: origen_163463.v · Open raw
module origen_163463(
    input wr_en,
    input rd_en,
    input [2:0] state,
    input [3:0] data_count,
    output reg [2:0] next_state
);

reg write_state, read_state, full_state, empty_state, noop_state;

always @(*) begin
    write_state = (wr_en == 1'b1) && (rd_en == 1'b0) && (data_count < 4'd8);
    read_state = (wr_en == 1'b0) && (rd_en == 1'b1) && (data_count > 4'd0);
    full_state = (data_count == 4'd8);
    empty_state = (data_count == 4'd0);
    noop_state = ((wr_en == 1'b0) && (rd_en == 1'b0)) || ((wr_en == 1'b1) && (rd_en == 1'b1));
end

always @(*) begin
    case (state)
        3'b000: // INIT
            next_state = 3'b001; // NO_OP
        3'b001: // NO_OP
            if (write_state)
                next_state = 3'b010; // WRITE
            else if (read_state)
                next_state = 3'b011; // READ
            else if (full_state)
                next_state = 3'b100; // WR_ERROR
            else if (empty_state)
                next_state = 3'b101; // RD_ERROR
            else
                next_state = 3'b001; // NO_OP
        3'b010: // WRITE
            next_state = 3'b001; // NO_OP
        3'b011: // READ
            next_state = 3'b001; // NO_OP
        3'b100: // WR_ERROR
            if (noop_state)
                next_state = 3'b001; // NO_OP
            else
                next_state = 3'b100; // WR_ERROR
        3'b101: // RD_ERROR
            if (noop_state)
                next_state = 3'b001; // NO_OP
            else
                next_state = 3'b101; // RD_ERROR
        default:
            next_state = 3'b001; // NO_OP
    endcase
end

endmodule
